backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profiles, product catalog, orders with payment methods (UPI/COD), mobile recharge, shopping cart, billing system, and admin access control with role-based permissions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that handles data migration from old actor state (with adminId and adminPassword fields) to new actor state (empty object).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: admin dashboard redirect after login and fixing 404/access denied errors through proper routing configuration.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend React components, pages, and hooks including routing, product management, cart, checkout, admin dashboard, and authentication flows.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, app icons, manifest link, and camera permission description for barcode scanning functionality.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, and display settings for Maa Bhawani General Store progressive web app.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls with offline fallback support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin dashboard, billing, and settings pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authentication wrapper implementing hardcoded admin login (ID: 919708075648, Password: 979142876085) with 24-hour session persistence in localStorage and automatic redirect to /admin/dashboard upon successful authentication.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, barcode, and image upload. Includes validation, duplicate barcode checking, and upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images, details, and delete functionality. Includes loading skeletons and confirmation dialog for product deletion.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: Camera-based barcode scanner component using Quagga2 library loaded from CDN. Features flash toggle, haptic feedback, beep sounds, and scan cooldown to prevent duplicates.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Table displaying all generated bills with search functionality, view/print dialogs, and CSV export capability. Shows bill details including customer info and totals.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Print-ready bill template component formatted for 80mm thermal printers. Displays shop header, bill details, itemized list, and total with customizable slogan.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button in bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the shop number (9142876085).
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Side drawer displaying cart items with swipe-to-close gesture support. Shows product list, subtotal, and buttons for checkout and clearing cart.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Renders a horizontal scrollable list of category filter buttons, highlighting the selected category.
Displays an alert with delivery policy information: free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches rendering errors and displays a fallback UI with error details and recovery options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying store information, contact details, delivery info, and attribution with caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header with logo, navigation links, cart button with item count, and login/logout functionality using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that includes Header, Footer, CallUsButton, and renders children in a flex container.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Form component for mobile recharge orders with fields for mobile number, operator selection, and amount, submitting via usePlaceRechargeOrder hook.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays payment QR code image with amount and UPI payment instructions for completing orders.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component displaying product image, name, category, price, and add-to-cart button with authentication check.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Grid layout displaying products with category filtering, loading skeletons, and empty state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart, orders, recharge orders, bills, and admin functions using the actor from useActor hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette using oklch, touch-friendly utilities, thermal printer styles for 80mm receipts, and barcode scanner laser animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabs for managing products, orders, recharge orders, and bills, displaying revenue statistics and order status management with real-time updates.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for configuring shop slogan with live preview using a mock bill template, includes navigation back to admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Point-of-sale billing interface supporting camera and manual barcode scanning, cart management with quantity adjustments, customer details input, and bill generation with print functionality.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page component that collects customer delivery details, calculates total price with delivery fees, supports UPI and COD payment methods, and places orders via backend mutations.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page displaying a store banner image, mobile recharge section, and product grid for browsing groceries.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page showing order ID, payment method, and conditional display of UPI QR code or COD instructions based on selected payment method.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Store information page displaying contact details, location map, delivery policy, store hours, and available services.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and session storage, supporting both hash-based and browser-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended theme settings, container queries, typography, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document for implementing hardcoded admin authentication (ID: 919708075648, Password: 979142876085) with 24-hour session persistence and direct dashboard redirect.
